company.name: Cytomate
company.shortDescription: Cytomate builds tools for simulating cyberattacks, red teaming, and penetration testing to detect and fix security risks.
company.description: Cytomate is the cybersecurity company that develops proprietary technology in-house. The company offers advanced solutions and services focused on offensive security, including Red Teaming, Penetration Testing, and Reverse Engineering. Its flagship product, Breach+, is a comprehensive Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS) platform that enables organizations to identify network security gaps and effectively prioritize security investments. By simulating a broad range of cyberattacks within a controlled environment, Breach+ supports organizations in safeguarding their assets and data while reducing their overall risk exposure.
